# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## FREE Chocolate Chip Cookie at select locations

## FREE Chocolate Chip Cookie at select locations  
FREE chocolate chip cookie with a purchase on a Penguins home game day. Offer available at these Pittsburgh locations: North Fayette, Cranberry, and Bethel Park.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## Pens Win, You Win!

## Pens Win, You Win!  
When the Penguins win at home, you score $10 off $50 or more at DICK'S Sporting Goods. Valid for next 7 days. Offer and restrictions inside the Penguins app.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## DICK'S Sporting Goods Jr. Starter of the Game

## DICK'S Sporting Goods Jr. Starter of the Game  
The DICK'S Sporting Goods Jr. Starter of the Game gets to stand next to members of the Pittsburgh Penguins during the National Anthem. To participate in this contest, parents or guardians of a youth hockey player or goalie between the ages of 8 and 12 should submit a brief essay written by the player that explains how they demonstrate the qualities of a Jr. Starter.  
* Enter Now

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## Eat'n Park Chili Goal! 7 Goals!

## Eat'n Park Chili Goal! 7 Goals!  
Get a free cup of chili at participating Eat'n Park locations if the Penguins score 7 goals at home. Available the following day, starting at 11am. Guests must present mobile ticket in Google or Apple Wallet. One per check, valid for dine-in only with purchase.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## F.N.B. We're Behind Every Goal

## F.N.B. We're Behind Every Goal  
As a testament to its dedication to our local community, First National Bank has committed to donate $200 to the Greater Pittsburgh Community Food Bank for every goal the Penguins score during the 2025.26 season.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## Giant Eagle Season Saves

## Giant Eagle Season Saves  
For every shot saved by Penguins' goalies at home this season, Giant Eagle will donate $10 to Veterans Place.

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## Big Mac Attack

## Big Mac Attack  
If the Penguins score during the final five minutes of the 3rd period of any game during the 2025-26 NHL season, YOU win a Free Big Mac! Should the Penguins score, be sure to download your McDonald's app to receive a FREE Big MacÂ® with purchase. Offer is valid for three days following the game where the Penguins score on the Big Mac Attack.  
* Learn More

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## Half Off Rusty's Shake Days

## Half Off Rusty's Shake Days  
The Milkshake Factory is giving Penguins fans half off Rusty's Shake throughout the season! If Bryan Rust scores a goal, you get half off Rusty's Shakes the next day. Rusty's Shake is a chocolate shake with brownies, cookies and cream and hot fudge â topped with a chocolate number 17. *Excludes PPG Paints Arena location  
* More Details

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## Morgan & Morgan Gives You More Bench Experience

## Morgan & Morgan Gives You More Bench Experience  
A chance to win an exclusive, premium experience for you and 3 guests courtesy of Morgan & Morgan! Winners will receive 4 F.N.B Club tickets to a 25-26 home Penguins game, 4 gift bags containing a Penguins autographed item, and the opportunity to watch the Penguins warm up right from the home bench!  
* Enter Now

# https://www.nhl.com/penguins/fans/contests
## The Davey Tree Score for the Trees Program

## The Davey Tree Score for the Trees Program  
The Pittsburgh Penguins and Davey Tree have partnered to plant trees in the greater Pittsburgh area! Every goal scored by a Penguin on home ice adds a number to the tree counter. The two organizations will work with Tree Pittsburgh to plant the total number of trees in or around the city to help restore the urban forest in Pittsburgh.  
* Learn More
